method: The 2026-09-21 federal pull set aside RIDB campgrounds whose nearest DB entry was 1.5-3 km away as presumed duplicates. Ladybird Landing (57 sites) proved that wrong. Re-pulled 2026-09-28: 215 in that band; 48 cited by rec.gov id, 6 matched by name, 10 non-campground names, 151 triaged -> 83 dropped by catalog (thin/no_rv), 1 already in DB (Quakertown), 67 to work.
